notes_for_editor: The Register is the only tower-specific source for the build year, removal range, volunteer staffing and cabin. The 1991 state survey is agency-wide background and does not name this tower; the story says so. Do not confuse with the Fort Lewis mansion near Salem (Virginia Room item RVNH40267, fire of 25 July 1949), a different building that was not used. No source describes the summit or public access today, so access is omitted from facts. No photo added.
